mapper.select: SELECT child_id FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'PARENT' WHERE cp.child_id = #{childId} AND cp.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission ( child_id, created_by_member_id, title, description, reward_amount, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{createdByMemberId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{rewardAmount}, 'ASSIGNED', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO notification ( member_id, child_id, notification_category, notification_type, title, content, reference_type, reference_id, metadata_json, deduplication_key, is_read, created_at ) SELECT c.member_id, c.child_id, 'MISSION', 'MISSION_ASSIGNED', '새 용돈 미션이 도착했어요', CONCAT( #{missionTitle}, ' 미션을 확인해 보세요. 완료 보상은 ', FORMAT(#{rewardAmount}, 0), '원이에요.' ), 'MISSION', #{missionId}, JSON_OBJECT( 'mission_id', #{missionId}, 'reward_amount', #{rewardAmount} ), CONCAT('MISSION_ASSIGNED:', #{missionId}), 0, #{createdAt} FROM child c WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.member_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE( ( SELECT np.enabled FROM notification_preference np WHERE np.member_id = c.member_id AND np.notification_category = 'MISSION' ), 1 ) = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child c INNER JOIN member requester ON requester.member_id = #{memberId} AND requester.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( ( requester.member_type = 'CHILD' AND c.member_id = requester.member_id ) OR ( requester.member_type = 'PARENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM child_parent cp WHERE cp.child_id = c.child_id AND cp.member_id = requester.member_id ) ) )

SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN status != 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS total_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS in_progress_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS needs_review_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS completed_count FROM mission WHERE child_id = #{childId}
